tei:div.tei:p: 385) bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul rgyun khyer ngag 'don nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bzhugs so/ 386)

skyabs gnas bla na ma mchis pa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lam zab bdud kyi gcod yul rgyun khyer ngag 'don du nyams su blang ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus shig bri bar bya ste/ de yang*/ phyag rdzogs sogs kyi nyams len kyi gnad rnams gdar sha chod pa ni mchog tu gal che ba'i phyir/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyi drung du zhun thar bcad la/ bog 'don du de nyid nyams su blang bar bya ste/ dur khrod dang lung stong la sogs gzhung nyid nas gsungs pa'i gnas sam/ rang gi mal sa nyid du lus ngag yid gsum zo glod nas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i ngang nas 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ de la 387) sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum la sa bcad nyer bdun gyis ston te/ dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro ni/ phaṭaḥ ma mkha' mnyam 'gro bsgrol slad du// bdag nyams len mchog la 'jug par bya// lus dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'a'abyor phun tshogs legs thob kyang*// tshe mi rtag 'chi mi rtag bsam pa/ ba'i rang bzhin can// gnas gar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran pa 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor te// dus da lta nas rtag 'dzin zhin spongs// phaṭaḥzil gnon gsum gyi dang po lha 'dra zil gyis gnon pa ni/ deng bdag dang khams sems can la 388) las gnod cing snang byed gdug pa can// lha 'dre srin mi ma yin gyi rigs/ kun bla med byang chub ma thob par// bdag sa phyogs 'di nas ci phyir 'gro /lus rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// sna g.yon nas byang chub sems kyi rlung*// dbyibs lcags kyu'i rnam pa bgegs kun bkug /khrom tshogs sa lta bu bdag drung 'khod// phyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas// skyabs mchog gsum rgyal ba sprin ltar bstibs// 'od me spungs 'bar ba'i gur gyis phub// gdon gegs tshogs sangs rgyas ma thob par// phyir 'gro ba'i go skabs med par gyur/

phaṭaḥganyis pa gnas zil gyi 389) gnon pa ni/ lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub 'di// dbyings gser gyi mchod rten ri rab tsam// 'od stong gsum gang bas sa phyogs kun// yongs khyab pas chir gyis non par gyur/ phaṭaḥgasum pa bdag zil gyis gnon pa ni/ sems ye stong spros bral nam mkha' bzhin// dbyings gdod ma'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ 'phral rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i zang zing kun// don blo 'das ngang du phyams kyi glod// phaṭaḥlus bya byed spyod lam rnam pa gsum gyis dang po stangs stabs bcu ni/ bdag rdo rje rnal 'byor brtul zhugs kyis// gnas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur// gar stangs stabs sna tshogs 'dul bar bya// phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ phaṭaḥ gnyis pa rnam snang chos bdun la gnas pa ni/ lus rnam 'gyur stangs stabs de dag kun// rtsal 'gag med rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul ste// slar rnam snang chos bdun lta stangs kyi// gnas mi 'gyur ri bo ltar brtan bya// phaṭaḥganyis pa lus kyi 'du shes bshig pa ni/ don blo 'das skye med ma rtogs 390) na// lus rtsol bcas spyod pa rnam g.yeng rgyu// sems 'dzin pas bcing ba yongs spangs nas// ci bde bar bsgyur zhing gang bar shog /phaṭaḥganyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang maṇḍal gyi rim pa ni/ steng spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i khar// pha dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// sku longs spyod rdzogs tshul ḍā dril bsnams// 'khor rgyud pa'i bla ma sprin ltar bstibs// 'od gzi mdangs 'bar bar bzhugs pa'i drung*// phyi rin chen stong gsum maṇḍal ma// yul gling bzhi ri rab tshom bur bkod// nang gdal khyab lpags pa'i maṇḍal la// lus phyi nang sha khrag tshom bur bkod// gzhi stong nyid dbyings kyi maṇḍal la// rtsal 'gag med rol pa'i tshom bur bkod// kun mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes nas kyang*// mchog tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// phaṭaḥ

na mo gu ru/ thugs bskyed med chos sku'i rol pa las// gsung 'gags med longs sku'i mdangs shar// sku gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'gro don mdzad// bdag gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje gzigs// don zab mo rgyal dgongs rgyud dgongs gcig bsdus pa'i// gnad ngo mtshar brda brda rgyud dang thabs kyi grol// tshig gdams ngag gang zag snyan rgyud snyan rgyud 'gro la ston// bdag gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje gzigs// kun gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// khyed thugs rje nus pa'i dpung bskyed la// bdag dug lnga'i nad kyis gzir ba'i tshogs// skyabs re sa khyod las gzhan ma mchis// dpal thugs rje gzigs shig rje btsun mgon// ༈ ces gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku// gnas gsum las 'od 'phros bdag la thim// sgo gsum gyi sgrib sbyang dbang bzhi thob// mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// sgo gsum gyi sgrib sbyangs dbang bzhi thob// mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// gsum pa yig brgya'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag rdo rje sems dpa' zhi 'dzum can// sku nam mkha'i khams gang thugs ka'i dbus// hūm̐ dkar po ri rab tsam gyi mthar// ma 'gro drug snang srid lha 'dra rnams// lus bskor ba byed cing yig brgya'i rgyun// sgra stong khams khyab pa bzlas par gyur/ om̐ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs hūm̐/ de 393)las 'od 'phros 'gro sgrib sbyangs// sku rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur cing*// mthar thams cad hūm̐ yig la thim ste// hūm̐/ bdag lus dang bcas pa mkha' la khyab// dbyings stong nyid ngang du mnyam par bzhag /phaṭaḥ'adi yan chad sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o/ de nas dngos gzhi la yang dgu las dang po gnad la bor ba rnam pa gsum gyi thog mar bdag nyid gnad la bor ba ni/bdag 'dzin pas bcing pa'i lus ngag yid// tshe thog dus nas bag chags shugs// blo 'khrul rtog chags sdang ngar 'dzin can// kun snying po med par kho thag chod// phaṭaḥganyis pa lha 'dre gnad la bor ba ni/

phyi phan byed lha dang gnod byed 'dre// 'di rmi lam nang gi dgra gnyen ltar// yid 'khrul pa'i rang mdangs shar ba las// gzhan gud na med par kho thag chod// phaṭaḥgasum pa gnyis med du gnad la bor ba ni/ yongs bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis snang ba// mig rab 394) rib can gyi 'khrul snang bzhin// don rang ngo shes na gnyis su med// de so sor 'dzin pa rtsad nas chod/ phaṭaḥ sems rig pa'i snying po 'od gong tshul// sgo tshang bug nas 'thon chos dbyings khyab// lusartsa khams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha// gnas zag med rang bzhin dbyings su gshegs// khral 'byung 'das gdos bcas phung po 'di// bdag sgyu ma'i lus kyi thod pa de// khyon stong gsum tsam gyur gtsug pa'i nang*// lus gzugs phung bsil mar btub pas bkang*// bcud sha snga bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa'i// steng zla gdan dpa' bo 'bru om̐ hūm̐ tram̐ hrī ā/ lngas mtshan// 'og ye shes rlung g.yos me sbar bas// rdzas khol ba'i rlangs pa 'bru lngar phog /'og phyogs bcur 'phros pas zhing kun nas// don ye shes bdud rtsi char phab pas// rdzas kun rdzob bdud rtsir dbyer med 'dres/ steng zla ba yig 'brur bcas pa zhu// bcud zag med bdud rtsir ro gcig gyur// phaṭaḥ dpal dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ mgon bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs// dbyings nam mkha' gang bar byon bzhugs nas// ljags 'od zer sbu gu'i tshul can gyis// lus bdud rtsir zhu ba rab gsol zhing*// thugs dgyes pa'i byin rlabs gnas gsum nas// 'od 'bru gsum dang bcas 'phros pa yis// bdag khams gsum sems can rnams la phog /las nyon mongs 396) sgrib byang sku gsum gyi// mchog thun mongs dngos grub kun thob gyur/ phaṭaḥganyis pa yul 'og ma la sbyin par btang ba ni/ slar mi zad gzugs kyi phung po ni// gnas stong gsum gang ba mchis pa la// om̐ āḥhūm̐ rang byung sgra grags pas// 'od ltem gyi bdud rtsir zhu ba las// zas btung ba gos rgyan khang khyim nor// su gang la ci 'dod longs spyod tshogs// rgya nam mkha'i khams kun yongs gang zhing*// rgyun 'khor ba ma stong de srid du// gang ci 'dod spyod kyang zag med gyur// phaṭaḥ

tshe 'khor ba thog med da bar du// drin 'khor med ris drug pha ma'i tshogs// bdag drin lan gzhal phyir sgyu ma'i lus// gang ci 'dod dngos por byin rlabs nas// sems nye ring med par tshogs su bsngo*// kun ji ltar 'dod pa longs spyad nas// lam bla med byang chub mngon gyur nas// phaṭaḥgasum pa yul bar ma la mgron du bgyes pa ni/ don ye stong rtsa bral ngang nyid las// 397) rtsal kun rtog 'khrul pa'i rang gzugs 'phrul// ming lha 'drer btags pa'i rnam 'gyur tshogs// gzugs ma nges sna tshogs ya ma zung*// dbyibs kha dog cha lugs du mar ldan// las gzhan la 'tshe ba'i gdug sems can// mtho srid rtse'i gnas nas dmyal khams bar// khyed mi min sha za 'byung po'i rigs// kun yud tsam cig gis 'dir 'dus shig /phaṭaḥ khyed sna tshogs cho 'phrul du ma yis// bdag gsod gcod brdeg brdung cir bstan kyang*// sems stong pa nyid la ji ltar byed// lus mi gtsang du ma'i phung po 'di// khyod sna tshogs cho 'phrul du ma yis// bdag gsod gcod brdeg brdung cir bstan kyang*// sems stong pa nyid la ji ltar byed// lus mi gtsang du ma'i phung po 'di// khyed 'dod na ci phyir bdag mi sbyin// phral 'tsho skyong dka' la gnod 'tshe mang*// phugs snying po med pa'i gzugs phung 'di// dus da lta sbyin pa'i yo byad du// gyur nus pa khyed rnams drin re che// mgo yan lag khog stong khog smad dang*// khrag sha lpags don snying nang rol rtsa// 398) skra sen mo ba spu'i mthar thug bar// mgron lha 'dre'i tshogs la gang 'dod sbyin// su ji ltar dgyes pa longs spyad nas// yid tshim pas gzhan la gnod spong zhing*// kun sangs rgyas sa la myur 'khod shog /phaṭaḥ bdag ngo shes shing thag chad pas/ 'khor gsum yongs dag ni/ gsum gyi dang po rang ngo rang gi ngo shes par bya ba ni/ sbyin par byed pa'i mkhan po dang*// yul gong yul gong bar sum mgron gyi rigs// rdzas sbyan rgyu'i phung por bcas pa kun// don mthar thug chos skur ro gcig nyid// phaṭaḥ

rang rig pa byang chub sems nyid la// dbyibs kha dog dngos po'i yul bral zhing*// gsal rig pa 'gags med stong mtha' bral// 'di sangs rgyas nyid du blo thag chod// phaṭaḥganyis pa yul snang rang rtsal du shes pa ni/ phyi gzung ba'i yul snang sna tshogs kyang*// nang 'dzin pas bcos shing btags pa las// don bden pa grub pa logs na med// sems gcig 399) pu'i rtsal du blo thag chod// phaṭaḥgasum pa 'khor 'das kyi chos de bka' shes rab phar phyin 'dir 'dus pa'i tshul ni/ tshig chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang*// don shes rabaphar phyin rtogs pa'i thabs// gnas rtsa ba rang rig stong pa nyid// gzhan gud na med par blo thag chod// phaṭaḥde yan chad rnams dngos gzhi'i larim pa'o/ rjes kyi rim pa la yang dgu las/ dang po bsgyur tshul gsum gyi thog mar lus zhen med du bsgyur tshul ni/ lus sgyu ma lta bu'i khang rul 'di// phral gces spras du mas bskyangs na yang*// phugs snying po med phyir nam yang 'jig /don de phyir gces 'dzin zhen pa bskyur// phaṭaḥganyis pa ngag brjod med du bsgyur tshul ni/ ngag brag cha lta bu'i lhang lhang po// 'di ji tsam brjod kyang zad mtha' bral// snyan mi snyan bzang ngan 'dzin pas bcings// 'di brjod med brjod bral ngang du bskyur// phaṭaḥgasum pa sems blo bral du bsgyur tshul ni/ sems kun rtog sna tshogs 'phro 'phro ba// 'di ji ltar bcos kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu// phaṭaḥkhyer so gsum gyi dang po dad pas rtsa ba gsum lam du khyer ba ni/ gzhi rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs gyur kyang*// lha bla ma'i mos gus mi spang zhing*// de res 'jog can du ma yin par// yid gus pas 'bral med lam du khyer// phaṭaḥganyis pa byams dang snying rjes ris drug lam du khyer ba ni/ don stong pa nyid la dbang thob kyang*// las rgyu 'bras bag yod dang ldan zhing*// ma khams gsum 'gro la ci phan blos// byams snying rje byang sems lam du khyer// phaṭaḥgasum pa the tshom gnyis 'dzin bral bas lha 'dre lam du khyer ba ni/

sems gshis kyi 'dug tshul 'tshang rig kyang*// phyi lha 'dre'i snang tshul khyad med pa// don gnyis su 'dzin pa dang bral bas// kun chos dbyings ngo bor lam du khyer// phaṭaḥmathar bsngo ba ni/ don 'di ltar ma rtogs 'gro kun kyang*// gnad ma nor mngon gyur 402)sangs rgyas shing*// de bsngo bya sngo byed sngo mkhan sogs// dbyings skye ba med pa'i klaung du phaṭaḥde ltar bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul gnyis 'dzin mngon zhen 'bri ba gcod pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid khrid gzhung nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar ngag 'don du bgyis chog pa zhig dgos zhes da lta yang yang mang pos bskul na'ang*/ gter gzhung gi rdo rje'i tshig sbram che ba rnams blo dman bdag 'dras dgongs pa lon pa'i nus pa ma mchis pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' la ras chod du 'gyur dgos na'ang*/ bskul ba rnams kyis ni 'di nyid gcig pu tshig khyer du bya ba'i yul ma yin pas de lta bu'i tshul rig par bya'o/ 'dis kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i las rkyen du gyur cig
